summary: The Proposal is revised to match the approved 025/026 Explore: projectOrdinal is assigned/frozen only when a Change first actually enters Explore and persisted once on the existing exact Change coordination entry; planned-only Changes do not reserve ordinals; semantic ChangeId remains canonical identity; Archive only consumes the persisted projectOrdinal and never allocates/recomputes from Delivery position, Run sequence, changeStartSequence, counts or physical grouping labels. Current Change remains projectOrdinal 021; planned Reviewer Guidance remains unassigned.
complexityGrowth: MINIMAL_REQUIRED; one existing coordination metadata field, no Registry/Counter/Allocator/lifecycle subsystem
